title: Trade Integration Across Afro-Eurasia
summary: Follows long-distance exchange from caravan systems to maritime expansion and global integration.
historical_significance: Shows how exchange networks reshaped states, ideas, and economies.
cross_era_connections: Links medieval exchange structures with early modern oceanic empires.
why_it_matters: Helps learners explain continuity and change in connectivity over centuries.

title: State Formation and Imperial Overstretch
summary: Compares expansion, legitimacy, and crisis across major state systems.
historical_significance: Connects institutional growth to internal and external pressure cycles.
cross_era_connections: Pairs premodern imperial consolidation with modern revolutionary and total-war states.
why_it_matters: Builds causal reasoning around how states scale and why they destabilize.

title: Migration Systems and Social Transformation
summary: Tracks migration as a long-duration engine of demographic and political change.
historical_significance: Highlights forced and voluntary movement as drivers of new social orders.
major_transitions: regional diffusion to coerced global displacement
cross_era_connections: Connects early population movement patterns to modern nation-state border crises.
why_it_matters: Supports synthesis on how mobility changes institutions, identity, and power.
